$comment: Standalone Claude Code marketplace manifest for md-publisher. Enables direct install via `/plugin marketplace add ehartye/md-publisher`. The single-plugin entry points at the repo root, where .claude-plugin/plugin.json defines the plugin itself.
name: md-publisher

metadata.description: Markdown to themed PDF/DOCX publishing pipeline with full mermaid support.

plugins.name: md-publisher
plugins.description: Turn markdown documents (with embedded mermaid) into themed, searchable, paged PDFs and Microsoft Word DOCX files via WeasyPrint and python-docx. 6 skills (publish, preprocess, theme-advisor, theme-gallery, install-fonts, rebuild-themes) + 8 bundled themes (atlas/phosphor/arcade/signal in light + dark) + interactive custom-theme creation.

system: GTK 3 runtime (Pango / Cairo / GDK-Pixbuf) — on Windows the easiest source is Inkscape or GIMP; on Linux apt install libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libgdk-pixbuf2.0-0; on macOS brew install pango cairo gdk-pixbuf libffi

plugins.firstRunBehavior: On first invocation of any skill, the plugin auto-installs a Python venv (WeasyPrint, markdown, Pygments, Pillow, python-docx, markdown-it-py, cairosvg, pytest) and Node deps (mermaid-cli + Puppeteer Chromium) to ~/.md-publisher/runtime/. Takes ~2 minutes; downloads ~250 MB; subsequent runs reuse the cache.
